error_message: M272 initial full CTest failed in whole-system mass audit with residual=0.057020 m3 after SWMM API-lateral bridge wiring.
root_cause: The concrete SWMM provider's raw external-net observation was passed to the audit without removing the API lateral component already represented by CouplingLib surface exchange.
fix: Added a separate SWMM API-lateral provider hook and subtract it from the audit observation before whole-system closure; existing mock audit remains unchanged.

error_message: M272 first bridge build failed because routingStep was not available in addExternalInflows(DateTime).
root_cause: The bridge initially attempted to accumulate API lateral volume at the inflow call site, although the existing routing-total integration already supplies the time interval.
fix: Kept API lateral as a step flow component integrated by massbal_updateRoutingTotals and restored addExternalInflows to its upstream currentDate-only signature.

error_message: G26 declared ci_gate:false in goldensuite.json but CTest labeled test_swmm_external_net as golden, so CI -L golden treated it as gating.
root_cause: The manifest checker enforced the golden label only for active gates and did not reject the label on non-gating entries.
fix: Changed G26 to candidate_non_gating and added a manifest invariant rejecting LABELS golden on implemented ci_gate:false tests.

error_message: SimDriver baseline sampled raw SWMM external net while epoch samples subtracted API lateral using a second observation.
root_cause: API lateral deduplication was split across two hooks and only applied to current epoch samples, making warm-start baselines inconsistent and observations non-atomic.
fix: SwmmEngine now exposes raw routing net plus a deduplicated audit net; SimDriver uses one deduplicated hook for both baseline and epoch samples.

error_message: MSBUILD error MSB1009: test_goldensuite_manifest.vcxproj does not exist.
root_cause: test_goldensuite_manifest is a CTest-only add_test registration, not a build target, but the verification command passed it to cmake --build --target.
fix: Build only executable targets and invoke test_goldensuite_manifest through ctest -R.
